items.name: BGM-71
items.description: A group of four who love tabletop games. They try to win battles with a single strike just so they can return to base as soon as possible to continue their game. Since the group is made up of weirdos, when they need to make a group decision, they draw cards to eliminate different opinions.

skills.name: Charged Missile
skills.description: Fire an enhanced missile after every 2 normal attacks to deal an extra #1 lethality to the center and increase this unit's pierce effect by #2. The first attack is always an enhanced missile.

skills.name: Reload Procedure
skills.description: Increase reload speed by #1 after every reload. Max 5 stacks.

skills.name: Thrill of the Hunt
skills.description: Increase lethality by #1 per hit on the same target. Max 5 stacks.

items.name: AGS-30
items.description: A trio with an abundance of curiosity and interest in the complex network of relationships among the Dolls. Rather than relying on gossip and hearsay, they prefer observing their subjects directly, which is why they can usually be spotted in the busiest place of the base.

skills.name: Super Grenade
skills.description: Every 4th attack will deal #1 lethality.

skills.name: Experience Highlight
skills.description: Increase precision by #1.

skills.name: AP Concussion
skills.description: Every attack has a 40% chance to inflict #1 pierce per second for #2 seconds.

items.name: 2B14
items.description: A trio with a lot of self-discipline. They follow the rules in both battles and daily routines. For them, breaking the rules is a very thrilling experience. All three of them have done it in secret before, but kept it a secret from each other to keep up their reputation.

skills.name: Battlefield Bombardment
skills.description: Launch an attack that deals #1 lethality to enemies within a radius of 4 every #2 seconds.

skills.name: Lesson in Pain
skills.description: Deal an extra #1 lethality against targets without a force shield.

skills.name: Obstruction Veil
skills.description: Every attack has a 40% chance to decrease enemy damage and accuracy by #1 for #2 seconds.

items.name: M2
items.description: A trio of Dolls who value group morale. They keep everyone's spirits high even when just setting up positions and they really enjoy doing it. The teddy bear they bring along everywhere takes up different roles depending on the situation—sometimes it's a liaison, sometimes it's even an avatar of the Commander.

skills.name: Curved Lightning Strike
skills.description: Fire an additional mortar after every 2 normal attacks to deal an extra #1 lethality to enemies within a radius of 2.

skills.name: Fatal Interference
skills.description: Place a stack on a random ally that increases their accuracy and evasion by #1 for #2 seconds for each group of enemies within the explosion range of this unit's attacks. Max 3 stacks per ally.

skills.name: Load Inertia
skills.description: Increase precision by #1 after every attack for #2 seconds. Max 3 stacks.

items.name: AT4
items.description: A trio of Dolls who love and pursue material comforts and always prepare ample supplies before a battle to make sure any needs can be met during combat. However, due to their desire for material comfort, they often end up fighting over who should handle the leftover supplies after the battle.

skills.name: Impact Sputter
skills.description: Attacks on targets with shield HP have a #1 chance to deal an extra #2 lethality to enemies within a radius of 2.5.

skills.name: Blinding Flash
skills.description: Attacks have a blinding effect that decrease the accuracy of enemies within the normal attack range by #1 for #2 seconds. Does not stack.

skills.name: Violent Burn
skills.description: Attacks have a burning effect that deal #1 lethality every 0.5 second to enemies within the normal attack range for #2 seconds.

items.name: QLZ-04
items.description: A trio of Dolls who believe firepower is paramount. Whenever they're deployed, they always carry more than double the required ammo and unleash it all on their enemies. They also pursue firepower in their diet—they love spicy food and always carry chilli peppers for seasoning.

skills.name: Misty Disruption
skills.description: Every 2 attack(s) additionally inflicts 1 smoke marker, which reduces the target's evasion and accuracy by #1, with a duration of #2 seconds.

skills.name: Sequential Strike
skills.description: Fire a special round 3 seconds after the battle begins, causing the target it strikes to take an additional #1 points of damage every time they are hit, with a duration of #2 seconds. Fire another special round every #3 seconds after that. This additional damage is not affected by damage-reducing effects, but it is affected by forcefields and damage caps (like Orthros).

skills.name: Aiming Flexibility
skills.description: Every 2 attacks, increase self support damage and accuracy by #1 for 20 seconds, to a maximum of 3 stacks.

items.name: Mk 153
items.description: A trio of Dolls who love street culture. They often attend underground gigs as a rap band. To build up their reputation, they always leave behind a graffiti of their band logo on both the stage and battlefield.

skills.name: Assault Shell
skills.description: Fire an extra round when attacking a new target. This round has #1 of a normal attack's lethality and pierce.

skills.name: Pinpointing Signal
skills.description: Fire a tracer shot before each normal attack, dealing #1 damage to the target while also reducing its evasion by #2 for #3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If the tracer shot hits, the area damage from the following normal attack is a guaranteed hit.

skills.name: Follow-Up Suppression
skills.description: Inflicting pierce damage on a target also inflicts #1 vulnerability for#2 seconds. If an attack from this unit breaks a forcefield, additionally stun the target for #3 seconds and deal #4 damage.

items.name: PP-93
items.description: A trio of Dolls who love camping. They often head out into the wild together on survival adventures, which makes them exceptionally successful even when fighting under terrible conditions. However, due to their excessive enthusiasm for camping, they often serve guests from other squads at the base with all kinds of canned food.

skills.name: Exploding Seals
skills.description:
Every #1 seconds, deal #2 damage to enemy units within a radius of 4, the more Dummies a target has, the higher the damage. Maximum damage is capped at #3.
 Additionally, set an area of 1.5 on fire, dealing 0.3x damage over time every 1 seconds, lasting 5 seconds.

skills.name: Extra Firepower
skills.description:
When fighting a battle initiated by the enemy, increase damage of all echelon members by #1 and reduce damage taken by #2 for #3 seconds.
 When initiating a battle, Skill 1 comes with additional Firepower Suppression, reducing damage dealt by enemy units within attack range by #4, lasting #5 seconds.

skills.name: Suppress and Snipe
skills.description:
The farther away the target is, the higher the damage, with the damage increase capped at #1.
 The closer the target is, the higher the precision, with the precision increase capped at #2.

items.name: Mk 47
items.description: An aloof yet coordinated trio who primarily communicate in a non-verbal fashion, but as a result they have perfect coordination and can precisely strike the enemy. Supposedly, they often fight among themselves when dividing the spoils of war, but this rumor has never been verified.

skills.name: Clearance Order
skills.description: Fires 3 airbursting grenades and deals a total of 15 instances of #1 link-scaling damage within three random areas, dealing half damage to armored units.

skills.name: Endurance Reversal
skills.description: Reduces the damage penalty of regular attacks. When making regular attacks, each instance of damage on the same target after the first has its damage penalty reduced to #1.

skills.name: Shieldbreaker's Keenness
skills.description: Each grenade fired by each regular attack applies additional damage that is only effective against shields. Enemy units within the grenades' area of effect take an additional #1 of self pierce to their shields.

items.name: RPG-29
items.description: A trio of connoisseuses who often critiques their enemies on the battlefield from head to toe and give them scores. They also do that to their companions off the battlefield, and the one who scores the highest is consistently the one sitting in the command center.

skills.name: Pulse Missile
skills.description: After every 2 shots, fire an augmented missile (first shot is always an augmented missile), dealing additional #1 damage that ignores shields, force fields and evasion, and #2 shield damage, while also causing the target to short-circuit (unable to move or attack) for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Blast Analysis
skills.description: RPG-29 deals #1 more damage to an enemy unit for every 10% HP they lose. Damage increase is capped at 30%.

skills.name: Core Meltdown
skills.description: RPG-29 deals #1 more damage to an enemy unit for every stack of debuff they have, capping at 5 stacks.

items.name: L9A1
items.description: A trio of young Dolls who are already thinking about retirement. They think about living leisurely after retirement all day long, utilizing this goal as their greatest motivation in combat. They can't help but keep on taking double their given assignments, in order to inject more funds into their retirement savings.

skills.name: Tracer Burst Grenade
skills.description:
Fire a special round that deals #1 damage within a radius of 4 every 2 shots.
During day battles, additionally fire a smoke grenade. Enemies caught in the smokescreen have their accuracy reduced by 50% and movement speed reduced by 30% for 3 seconds.
During night battles, additionally increase allied units' night vision by 80% for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Armor-Breaking Resonance
skills.description: Normal attacks additionally reduce enemy armor by #1 within range for 3 seconds. At the same time, grant all allied units a shield equivalent to #2 of a single dummy link's HP, with armored units receiving double the shield value. This lasts for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Fissure Tracking
skills.description: Normal attacks will apply 3% vulnerability to a random target. This skill will occur 3 times, then additionally apply a #1 vulnerability to enemies within attack range. Both effects last for 3 seconds.
